faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Dubai Design District Free Zone.

items.a: D3 is the Middle East's first creative free zone dedicated to design, fashion, art, and culture. It's home to 500+ creative businesses from around the world.

items.q: What activities can I run in D3?
items.a: Design & branding, fashion & textile, visual arts & photography, creative agencies, architecture, and digital media are all permitted activities.

items.q: How long does D3 setup take?
items.a: Typically 3-5 working days with proper documentation. Our team ensures a smooth process.

items.q: Can I get 100% foreign ownership in D3?
items.a: Yes. D3 allows 100% foreign ownership — no local sponsor required.

items.q: What are the tax benefits of D3?
items.a: 0% corporate and personal income tax with full repatriation of profits and capital.

items.q: What office spaces are available in D3?
items.a: Hot desks, creative studios, fitted offices, retail spaces, and shell & core options.

items.q: Can I open a bank account with a D3 license?
items.a: Yes. We help open corporate bank accounts with top UAE banks based on your business profile.
Yes. D3 offers freelance permits and hot desks designed for independent creatives.

items.q: Can I sponsor my family with a D3 license?
items.a: Yes. D3 supports family visa sponsorship along with investor and employment visas.

items.q: What support does Setup Zone Dubai provide?
items.a: We handle company registration, license issuance, visas, bank accounts, and ongoing business advisory.
